class_id: listing exchange recorded from bidding venue
symptom: a row's `listing_exchanges` includes an exchange that only ran the BIDDING for the issue, not an exchange the issue will actually list on. The exchange that runs bidding for an issue is not necessarily a listing venue for it — mainboard issues sometimes bid through NSE while the offer document and RHP name only BSE as the designated stock exchange.
first_seen: 2026-09-23, NSE (National Stock Exchange of India Ltd) IPO itself: price band ad says "(To be listed on the main board of BSE)", "BSE LIMITED SHALL BE THE DESIGNATED STOCK EXCHANGE"; RHP p.3 "proposed to be listed on BSE"; Chittorgarh "Listing at: BSE" — yet staging `listing_exchanges` holds ["BSE","NSE"] because NSE ran the bidding (symbol NSE, series EQ). Issue #938. Bears on OD-64.
fix_prs: PARTIAL, branch fix/951-consolidated-save-unclaimed-fields (2026-09-26). The RULE (whether an exchange feed may add a board it only runs bidding for) is PENDING AN OWNER DECISION: spec row 17 ranks NSE > BSE > CG for listing_exchanges (E-1), and F-135 has no OD row; a first attempt that made exchange feeds a listing source only for SME issues was reverted as a spec change. What landed: (1) the set-merge (data-consolidation-service Case 2b) records a widened set under the source that ADDED the member, with the prior source as previous_source -- the NSE IPO's staging row read {source DRHP, value [BSE,NSE], previous '["BSE"]', previous_source DRHP}, crediting DRHP with a board it never named; (2) the filing persister's echo of the stored boards is context under both key spellings (listingExchange / listingExchanges) on the consolidation, persister-union and fallback doors. Existing wrong rows are NOT repaired (data contract). Issue #938 stays open.
detection_check: none at the table level. Write-time regression tests only: `scraper/tests/unit/services/consolidated-save-claimed-fields-951-938.test.ts` (#938 provenance block) and `filing-echo-listing-exchange-context-938.test.ts`.
